player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} ukax mayniwa Reverse Tic Tac Toe satiwina.  Q'arañaxa '{symbol}' ukaxa.
Uñt'ayasiwa kimsa janq'u jan wali (p'iqipxi, sayaqpxi, ukatx jan wali).
Jumax kimsa janq'u jan wali ukaxa, jaytani.
K'utxiwixa k'utxi sati '[4]' ukaxa q'arañaxa 4 satiwina.
Jumax Player {player_id} ukaxa, q'arañaxa '{symbol}' ukaxa, ukatx jupaxa '{opponent_symbol}' ukaxa.
